About Biolongevity Labs

Research-Grade Synthesis

BioLongevity Labs manufactures 99% purity research peptides using solid-phase peptide synthesis in USA-registered facilities that follow Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Our synthesis protocols prioritize molecular accuracy and batch consistency.

Each peptide undergoes rigorous quality control testing before release. We verify purity through HPLC, confirm molecular weight via LC-MS, and screen for contaminants.

Third-Party Testing Standard

We’re a leading peptide supplier that tests every batch through three independent, certified laboratories. No shortcuts. Your research deserves the highest quality peptides backed by certificates of analysis from external facilities-not just internal claims.

Peptides for In Vitro Research

Our catalog includes 150+ research-grade peptides for laboratory applications. All compounds ship with complete analytical documentation.

Need to buy peptides for your next study? Same-day shipping on orders placed before 12 PM PT. Free shipping over $400.

Supporting Scientific Research

BioLongevity exists to support laboratories conducting in vitro research. We provide the quality peptides and technical documentation your studies require.

Questions about our synthesis methods or quality control protocols? Contact our team and we will promptly respond to your inquiries.

Frequently Asked Questions

What quality testing do you provide?

Every peptide batch includes a Certificate of Analysis from SafeCert Labs, an independent CLIA certified facility. All chemical analysis is performed using HPLC with UV Detection coupled with Mass Spectrometry.

We’re the only research peptide supplier offering independent third-party testing by three different certified labs. Our testing protocols verify molecular identity, CAS number confirmation, purity levels (98%+ or 99%+), and appearance specifications.

All COAs are available before purchase so you can verify quality standards for your research applications.

How do I read your Certificates of Analysis?

Each COA displays the assession number, received date, reported date, and your specific product information (CAS number, quantity, identity, purity percentage, and appearance).

You’ll see two graphs: the HPLC chromatogram showing the purity peak, and the mass spectrometry data confirming molecular weight and identity. The specification table provides the result summary with exact purity percentage.

Every COA includes the testing lab’s principle chemist signature and the testing methodology used. Product photos show the actual vial appearance and labeling for verification.

Do you test for endotoxin contamination?

Each COA displays the assession number, received date, reported date, and your specific product information (CAS number, quantity, identity, purity percentage, and appearance).

You’ll see two graphs: the HPLC chromatogram showing the purity peak, and the mass spectrometry data confirming molecular weight and identity. The specification table provides the result summary with exact purity percentage.

Every COA includes the testing lab’s principle chemist signature and the testing methodology used. Product photos show the actual vial appearance and labeling for verification.

What purity level do I need?

Research applications typically require 95-99%+ purity for reliable results. Lower purity can introduce variables that interfere with in vitro studies and compromise data integrity.

Our 99%+ purity variants meet pharmaceutical-grade standards. Higher purity reduces experimental noise and gives you cleaner baseline data for your research protocols.

How long do reconstituted peptides last?

Reconstituted solutions remain stable for several days at 2-8°C. For longer storage, create small aliquots and freeze at -20°C or -80°C.

Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. Use sterile bacteriostatic water and aseptic technique when preparing solutions for multiple-use research applications.

What are your shipping times?

Most in-stock peptides ship the same day on orders placed before 12 PM PT. Domestic US orders arrive in 3-5 business days via standard shipping, or 1-2 days expedited.

We ship lyophilized peptides at ambient temperature in protective packaging. Free shipping on orders over $400.

Do you ship internationally?

We ship worldwide to qualified research institutions and laboratories. All international shipments include proper documentation: commercial invoices, Certificates of Analysis, MSDS, and “research use only” declarations.

Shipping times vary by region. You are responsible for any customs duties or import requirements in your jurisdiction.

What sizes are available?

Standard vial sizes range from 2mg to 10mg per peptide. We offer volume discounts starting at 3 vials (4-10% discount).

What is your return policy?

Due to temperature-sensitive storage requirements and the nature of research compounds, we don’t accept returns on shipped peptides.

We accept returns on unopened supplements within 10 days of delivery; all returns are subject to a 15% restocking fee and will be refunded minus the cost of the return shipping label.

How can I contact support?

Email us at help@biolongevitylabs.com for product questions, technical specifications, or order assistance. We respond within 24-48 hours during business hours (Monday-Friday, 9 AM-5 PM PT).

What if my order doesn't arrive?

Contact us immediately if tracking shows delivery but you haven’t received your package. If the carrier confirms non-delivery, we’ll reship at no cost.

We stand behind our shipping guarantee. Your research timeline matters, and we work quickly to resolve any delivery issues.

Have more questions? Contact our team for information about specific peptides or orders.
